headline.zh-Hant: 港大 · 文學士及工學學士（AI 及數據科學）
headline.zh-Hans: 港大 · 文学士及工学学士（AI 与数据科学）

tagline.en: I build small, complete tools — and write down why they hold up.
tagline.zh-Hant: 我做嘅工具都細但完整，仲會寫清楚佢為咩成立。
tagline.zh-Hans: 我做的工具都小而完整，也会写清楚它为什么成立。

photoAlt.en: Pixel-art illustration of Harry OneZion at a desk, with the caption “one more leap of faith”.
photoAlt.zh-Hant: Harry OneZion 坐在書桌前的像素插畫，附有「為創造，再一次信仰之躍」的題字。

bio.en: I'm a second-year student at HKU, reading a five-year double degree — AI and Data Science on one side, AI and Humanities on the other. Most of what I build sits between the two.
bio.zh-Hant: 我係港大 year two 嘅學生仔，而家讀緊一個五年制雙學位——一邊係 AI 同數據科學，另一邊係 AI 同人文。我大部分作品，都係喺兩邊中間做出嚟嘅。
bio.zh-Hans: 我是港大二年级的学生，现在读的是五年制双学位——一边是 AI 与数据科学，另一边是 AI 与人文。我大多数作品，都落在两边之间。

bioPoints.en: Ask whether the frame is right before asking how to build inside it. A fast answer to the wrong question is still wrong.
bioPoints.zh-Hant: 先問個框架啱唔啱，再問點做。框架錯咗，做幾快都係錯。
bioPoints.zh-Hans: 先问框架对不对，再问怎么做。框架错了，做得再快也是错。

bioPoints.en: Break it down until every piece can be checked. That is what finished means.
bioPoints.zh-Hant: 拆到每一嚿都驗證得到，先算拆完。
bioPoints.zh-Hans: 拆到每一块都能验证，才算是拆完。

bioPoints.en: No evidence I can point at, no claim that it is done.
bioPoints.zh-Hant: 冇指得出嘅證據，就唔會話做好咗。
bioPoints.zh-Hans: 没有指得出来的证据，就不会说做好了。

cvSummary.en: Second-year student at HKU reading a five-year double degree: AI and Data Science, and AI and Humanities. Most of what I build sits between the two — engineering that has to hold up in front of people, answering questions about people — questions only engineering can answer at scale.
cvSummary.zh-Hant: 香港大學二年級學生，修讀五年制雙學位：AI 及數據科學，以及 AI 及人文。作品多位於兩者之間：既要有站得住人前的工程，也要回答只有工程才答得到、關於人的問題。
cvSummary.zh-Hans: 香港大学二年级学生，修读五年制双学位：AI 与数据科学，以及 AI 与人文。作品多介于两者之间：既要有站得住人前的工程，也要回答只有工程才回答得了的、关于人的问题。

body.en: A private control plane for personal agents — six layers from input to memory to execution. Local only, reachable over Tailscale, 669 contract tests green as of 2026-11-05.
body.zh-Hant: 個人 Agent 的私有控制面——由輸入、記憶到執行共六層。只在本地運行，經 Tailscale 存取；截至 2026-11-05，669 個契約測試全綠。

body.en: Engineer at a DSE tutoring team: the public site and content system, which the team updates without a developer, plus the DSE Paper 3 Part A production system behind its course products.
body.zh-Hant: DSE 補習團隊的工程師：負責對外網站與內容系統，團隊不用開發者也能自行更新；同時負責課程產品背後的 DSE Paper 3 Part A 生產系統。

body.en: AI and Data Science, plus AI and Humanities. Coursework stays off this site; the projects here are self-run.
body.zh-Hant: AI 同數據科學，加埋 AI 同人文。Coursework 唔會放上呢個網站；呢度啲項目都係自己做嘅。
body.zh-Hans: AI 与数据科学，加上 AI 与人文。课业不会放到这个网站上；这里的项目都是我自己做的。
